# Phone Dashcam

> Free Android dashcam app by CyberLab Automation. Turns any Android phone into a full-featured dashcam with parking mode, crash detection, and a built-in database of 336,000+ speed cameras, Flock Safety ALPR readers, and red light cameras across the United States.

## About

Phone Dashcam is a free Android application developed by CyberLab Automation, an independent software studio focused on automotive safety tools. The app requires no subscription — core dashcam features are free, with an optional one-time $9.99 Pro upgrade that unlocks the camera alert database and AI object detection.

The app works entirely on-device: video is stored locally, AI processing runs on-device, and no footage is sent to any server. Cloud backup goes to the user's own Google Drive account.

## Key Features

- Loop recording (1080p, 720p, 480p with optional audio)
- Parking mode: screen dims to near-zero, motion detection saves clips
- Crash and impact detection: automatically saves footage on sudden deceleration
- Google Drive cloud backup (WiFi-only option available)
- Live speedometer and trip tracker
- GPS photo capture (geotagged photos from the dashcam feed)
- Dual camera recording (front + rear simultaneously)
- 336,000+ camera location alerts (Flock Safety ALPR, speed cameras, red light cameras) — Pro feature
- AI object detection — Pro feature

## App Availability

- Platform: Android 8.0+
- Free download on Google Play
- Developer: CyberLab Automation
- Contact: cyberlab.automation@gmail.com
